timeline.content: team goal is to design and implement an AR archery system, involving a physical bow the user can shoot virtual targets with. A microphone will be attached to the bow to allow the user to provide voice commands to the game, and a glove with an IMU and flex sensors will be given to allow the users to perform gestures to affect the game state as well. constraints include a 200 dollar budget, and a deadline of mid april. Success critieria would be getting a B in the final grade
